_readme.note: Sanitized for public sharing. Replace all YOUR_* placeholders with your own values before importing into n8n.
setup_steps: 1. Add a Microsoft SQL Server credential in n8n (Settings > Credentials) and note its ID
2. Add a second read-only SQL credential if desired
3. Add your Pinecone API key as an HTTP Header Auth credential or inline in the Pinecone /query node
4. Replace all YOUR_* tokens in this file with real values
5. Ensure Ollama is running locally at 127.0.0.1:11434 with nomic-embed-text pulled
6. Import into n8n via Settings > Import Workflow

placeholders.YOUR_PINECONE_API_KEY: From console.pinecone.io — Api-Key header on Pinecone /query node
placeholders.YOUR_INDEX.svc.YOUR_REGION.pinecone.io/q: Your Pinecone index host URL (shown in index details)
placeholders.YOUR_SQL_CREDENTIAL: n8n credential name for your primary SQL Server connection
placeholders.YOUR_READONLY_SQL_CREDENTIAL: n8n credential name for read-only SQL connection
placeholders.YOUR_SQL_CRED_ID: Auto-assigned credential ID (visible in n8n credential URL)
placeholders.YOUR_READONLY_SQL_CRED_ID: Auto-assigned credential ID for read-only connection
Your SQL Server database name — replace in all SQL query nodes
placeholders.https://your-frontend.com: Origin to allow in CORS headers
placeholders.YOUR_WEBHOOK_ID: Auto-generated by n8n when workflow is activated

parameters.query:
SELECT ProdNo, Brand, Title, Category, LongDescription, AltTag, SizeScale
FROM your_db.dbo.Products
WHERE ProdNo = '{{ $json.originalQ }}'
-- TODO: Parameterize this query using n8n's $parameter syntax or a stored procedure
-- to prevent SQL injection. The originalQ field is SKU-validated upstream
-- but parameterization is best practice for production.

SELECT p.*, pa.*
FROM your_db.dbo.Products p
JOIN your_db.dbo.ProductAttributes pa ON p.ProductID = pa.ProductID
WHERE p.ProdNo = '{{ $json.Prodno }}'

SELECT p.*, pp.*
FROM your_db.dbo.Products p
JOIN your_db.dbo.ProductPrices pp ON p.ProductID = pp.ProductID
WHERE p.ProdNo = '{{ $json.Prodno }}'

-- Bestseller ranking: last 30 days revenue by SKU
SELECT TOP (100) PERCENT
  od.ProdNo,
  SUM(od.Total) AS Expr1
FROM your_db.dbo.Orders o
JOIN your_db.dbo.OrderDetails od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID
WHERE o.OrderDate > GETDATE() - 30
GROUP BY od.ProdNo
ORDER BY Expr1 DESC

-- Active discounts/sales: returns records where today falls within the date range
DECLARE @today date = CONVERT(date, GETDATE());
SELECT
  s.SpecialID, s.SpecialType, s.SpecialItem,
  s.SpecialDiscount, s.SpecialStartDate, s.SpecialEndDate
FROM your_db.dbo.Specials s
WHERE s.SpecialStartDate < DATEADD(day, 1, @today)
  AND s.SpecialEndDate  >= @today;
